events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect the daily Zoom check script, its log and job state
events.input: $ wc -l workshop-plan/ops/zoom_support_check.mjs && tail -25 /Users/adithyamurali/Library/Logs/tantra-zoom-support-check.log | cut -c1-400 && grep -n "refused\|admin\|fetch(\|revops-admin-key\|headers" workshop-plan/ops/zoom_support_check.mjs | cut -c1-220 | head -50 && launchctl list | grep zoom-support; git log --oneline -5 -- workshop-plan/ops/zoom_support_check.mjs

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the check script and how other scripts and the centre handle admin auth
events.input: $ sed -n 1,140p workshop-plan/ops/zoom_support_check.mjs | cut -c1-260; echo ----; grep -n "admin-key\|x-admin\|authorization\|admin/enter\|cookie" workshop-plan/ops/tracker_sync.py workshop-plan/ops/deliver.py | cut -c1-220 | head -20; echo ----; grep -n "admin/enter\|x-admin-key\|isAdmin\|function adminOk\|ADMIN_KEY" cloud/src/*.ts | cut -c1-200 | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read targeted ranges of the check script and admin auth references
events.input: $ sed -n 32,42p workshop-plan/ops/zoom_support_check.mjs | cut -c1-240; sed -n 60,82p workshop-plan/ops/zoom_support_check.mjs | cut -c1-240; echo ----; grep -n "admin-key\|x-admin\|uthorization\|admin/enter\|ookie" workshop-plan/ops/tracker_sync.py workshop-plan/ops/deliver.py | cut -c1-220 | head -14; echo ----; grep -n "admin/enter\|x-admin-key\|ADMIN_KEY\|rc_admin\|Set-Cookie\|set-cookie" cloud/src/*.ts | cut -c1-220 | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the current sign-in flow in tracker sync and the centre
events.input: $ sed -n 118,136p workshop-plan/ops/tracker_sync.py | cut -c1-240; echo ----; sed -n 1024,1040p cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-260

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read meeting selection, rerun the job under launchd, and show the task's blocker and latest log
events.input: $ sed -n 83,100p workshop-plan/ops/zoom_support_check.mjs | cut -c1-260; echo ----; launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.tantra.zoom-support-check; sleep 45; launchctl list | grep zoom-support; tail -1 /Users/adithyamurali/Library/Logs/tantra-zoom-support-check.log | cut -c1-200; echo ----; python3 - <<'E'
